No two consecutive words can share the same first letter. Write a descriptive, fictional, imaginative screenplay of a fish being pulled out of the water by a human and made to stare at the solar eclipse. The fish descends into a lovecraftian monologue about "horrors beyond it's comprehension" and has an existensial crisisassistant
response:
FADE IN:

EXT. BEACH - DAY

The sun beats down on the sandy shore as a human, JEN (30s), wades into the ocean, her eyes scanning the water for signs of life. Suddenly, she spots a fish, FINLEY (a sleek, silver fish), swimming near the surface. She reaches out a hand, and Finley is sucked into her grasp.

JEN
(excitedly)
Oh, look at you! You're so beautiful!

Finley struggles and squirms in Jen's hand, but she holds tight. Jen pulls Finley out of the water and onto the beach, where Finley lies flailing on the sand.

JEN
(curiously)
What's wrong, little guy? You're not used to being out of the water, are you?

Finley looks up at Jen with a mixture of fear and confusion. Jen holds him up to the sky, and Finley's gaze follows the sun as it begins to darken.

JEN
(amused)
Oh, look! A solar eclipse! Isn't it amazing?

Finley's eyes widen in terror as the sun's corona appears, casting an otherworldly glow over the beach. Finley's body begins to convulse, and he speaks in a voice that is both familiar and yet, utterly alien.

FINLEY
(whispering)
The void... it's coming... the void is coming...

JEN
(confused)
What's wrong, Finley? You're scaring me!

FINLEY
(urgently)
You don't understand... the horrors beyond your comprehension... the eldritch abominations that lurk beyond the veil of reality... they're coming for us all...

Finley's monologue grows more frantic, his words tumbling out in a maddening torrent.

FINLEY
(whispering)
The cyclopean cities of R'lyeh... the twisted, non-Euclidean geometry of the abyssal planes... the crawling chaos that defies all rational understanding...

Jen's expression changes from amusement to concern as Finley's words become more and more unhinged.

JEN
(backing away)
Finley, stop! You're scaring me!

FINLEY
(eyes bulging)
You can't understand... you can't comprehend... the abyssal horrors that lurk beyond the veil... they're coming for us all...

Finley's body begins to contort and twist, his scales glistening with an otherworldly sheen. Jen takes a step back, her eyes wide with fear.

JEN
(terrified)
What have I done?

Finley's monologue reaches a fever pitch as he descends into madness.

FINLEY
(whispering)
I am but a mere mortal... a fleeting moment in the grand tapestry of time... and yet... and yet... I am aware of the abyssal void that yawns open before me... a void that threatens to consume all in its path...

Finley's body begins to dissolve into a pool of shimmering, iridescent scales as he speaks the final words.

FINLEY
(whispering)
I am but a mere fish... a mere mortal... and yet... I am aware of the horrors beyond my comprehension...

The camera zooms out as Finley's body disappears into the void, leaving Jen standing alone on the beach, her eyes fixed on the darkening sky.

JEN
(whispering)
What have I done?

FADE TO BLACK.

FADE IN:

EXT. BEACH - LATER

Jen stands alone on the beach, her eyes fixed on the darkened sky. She looks lost and confused, her expression a mixture of fear and wonder.

JEN
(whispering)
What have I done?

The camera lingers on Jen's face as the sound of Finley's monologue fades into the distance, a haunting reminder of the horrors that lurk beyond the veil of reality.

FADE TO BLACK.

THE END.
